# dhi_catalog_repository (Data Source)

Look up a single DHI catalog repository by name. Returns tag definitions, platforms, and other metadata.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Repository name (e.g. `golang`). Prefixes like `dhi/` or `dhi.io/` are stripped automatically.

### Read-Only

- `display_name` (String) Human-readable display name.
- `fips_compliant` (Boolean) Whether any FIPS-compliant variants are available.
- `namespace` (String) Repository namespace.
- `platforms` (List of String) Supported platforms (image repositories only).
- `short_description` (String) Short description of the repository.
- `stig_certified` (Boolean) Whether STIG-certified variants are available.
- `tag_definitions` (Attributes List) Available tag definitions. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tag_definitions))
- `type` (String) Repository type: `IMAGE` or `HELM_CHART`.

<a id="nestedatt--tag_definitions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tag_definitions`

Read-Only:

- `display_name` (String) Display name.
- `fips_compliant` (Boolean) FIPS compliant.
- `id` (String) Tag definition ID.
- `stig_certified` (Boolean) STIG certified.
- `tag_names` (List of String) Tag names.
